proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4963.1 chagala explicitly gives Oriya cheḷi, Palula chēli and Bihari/Bhojpuri cherī “goat”. The survey forms fit the single-consonant branch rather than separately numbered geminate or extended stems. Joint comparison: AdivasiOriya cʰeli “goat” matches reviewed Phal cʰēlī “goat” (f_xtmgtxetqft7a). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
